high_level_description: This image depicts a stylized representation of Earth from space, viewed at night. The planet is illuminated with vibrant colors, creating a striking contrast against the black background of space. The continents are outlined in various hues, including shades of purple, blue, green, and red, which highlight different regions of the Earth. The image does not contain any people or objects other than the Earth itself. The setting is outer space, as indicated by the dark expanse surrounding the planet.
